builds.source_note: Built before the commit; all four changed files were subsequently verified against the committed Git blobs using their recorded LF SHA-256 hashes.

retained_diagnostics: SDK processing warned about SDK XML version 4 with a tool understanding versions up to 3.
The baseline build could not strip libmupdf_java.so and packaged it as-is.
Packaging reported no .so files for armeabi, riscv64, mips, and mips64.
The green compile reported deprecated Java APIs; Gradle reported deprecated features incompatible with Gradle 9.0.
limitations: Build task completion is established by the retained BUILD SUCCESSFUL summaries. The full shell invocations and process exit codes were not retained; reproduction commands are normalized, not asserted to be exact original invocations.
These existing builds were recovered without rerunning Gradle. APKs, raw logs, JDK, and local configuration remain outside the public lab repository.
APK metadata comes from Gradle output metadata and hashes identify the retained files; no installation, launch, rendering, navigation, or signing verification is claimed by this record.

The debug package keeps the upstream application ID for the separate disposable-runtime audit. It is not a published app release. Upstream README release guidance requires a different package name for a custom release.

Fitz native binaries came from the declared Maven dependency, not a locally rebuilt JNI tree. Upstream appcompat uses a dynamic 1.1.+ dependency. These artifacts are not claimed to be byte-reproducible across fresh dependency resolution or debug keys.
Successful assembly and a universal filename do not establish working native support for every generated ABI split. Application runtime results belong to the separate runtime investigation.
